Forecasting Ride Demand
Across Addis Ababa

Predict trips for 12 zones × 24 hours × 14 days = 4,032 forecasts
Using 10 months of history + weather + city events

165
Holidays · Football · Concerts
Conferences · Road closures

🎯 The Problem

A ride-hailing company needs to know — a day ahead — how many trips each zone will see each hour. Without a forecast, drivers are in the wrong place. Riders wait. Revenue is lost.

💡 Our Approach

  • 1
    Clean & Join all 3 raw tables
  • 2
    Engineer 18 features from time, weather, events
  • 3
    Train LightGBM on 10 months of history
  • 4
    Deploy interactive forecast demo

⏰ Clock Proof

Weather raw timestamps end in "Z" (UTC). After +3h conversion to EAT, temperature peaks at 15:00 local time — consistent with Addis Ababa afternoon heat. Wrong clock = wrong join = wrong model.
Analysis & Visualization · Key Findings

What the Data Tells Us

Two critical patterns the model must learn to produce useful forecasts

📈 Finding 1 — City-wide demand grew +51.9% from Jan to Oct 2025. November forecasts must account for this trend — a static model underestimates.
